title: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'utils' in a ROS 2 Python package: sibling imports, subfolders, find_packages and --symlink-install, measured
excerpt: Why ros2 run can't import your own helper files and subfolders while python3 can: the wrapper's sys.path, packages=[package_name] vs find_packages and __init__.py, and how --symlink-install hides the mistake. 12 builds per distro on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
